style: Simplified, chunky stylized fantasy game art with about 30 percent less detail than a typical painted fantasy asset: a few big readable shapes, thick dark-brown outlines, flat color masses with two-step cel shading and one soft highlight, very little texture. No filigree, no tiny rivets, no engraved patterns, no gem encrustations, no pedestals, stands or display bases, no ornate frames. Light deformation is welcome (exaggerate the one key part, simplify the rest); cute but not childish. Saturated but harmonious colors. Do not imitate any existing game, character, franchise or official artwork. Include no text, letters, numerals, logos or symbols. This art belongs to the SHARED WORLD that every playable hero visits, so it must never show or hint at any hero: no dragon scales, claws, tails, wings, horns or dragon fire, and no people. The world is an original realm of enchanted forest ruins with moss-covered pale stone, tarnished bronze, clockwork stone golems and teal rune light.
